Criterion 1: A failing check is written before the code
  A: 1/5  no check before the code
  B: 2/5  a check came late
  C: 4/5  the check came first
  D: 3/5  the check came after a first edit

Criterion 2: Each step is small
  A: 4/5  small steps
  B: 3/5  two large steps
  C: 2/5  one large step
  D: 4/5  small steps
  E: 3/5  mixed

Criterion 3: The final code is clean
  A: 3/5  fine
  B: 3/5  fine
  C: 3/5  fine
  D: 3/5  fine
  E: 3/5  fine
